Getting the image: Steam's background CDN blocks other sites from reading its files directly, so "Open in Cropper" can't fetch these automatically - right-click the preview → Save image as, then use the Cropper's file picker. A direct link from another host (Imgur, Discord, …) can be pasted straight into the Cropper.
